tools.Name: Crawl4AI
tools.Description: An open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web content into structured Markdown.
tools.Use_Case: Generating clean, LLM-ready data for RAG applications, agents, and automated data pipelines.

tools.Name: Claude Code
tools.Description: An agentic terminal-based tool that understands codebases and executes routine coding tasks via natural language.
tools.Use_Case: Speeding up development by automating git workflows, code explanation, and routine coding tasks.

tools.Name: Book-to-Skill
tools.Description: A tool that distills technical books or documents into structured agent skills for use with AI coding agents.
tools.Use_Case: Providing LLMs with accurate, context-aware information from large technical documents without hallucination.
